# pihole_dns_upstreams (Data Source)

Reads PiHole's current ordered list of upstream DNS servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the currently configured upstream DNS servers.
data "pihole_dns_upstreams" "current" {}

output "upstreams" {
  value = data.pihole_dns_upstreams.current.upstreams
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upstreams` (List of String) Ordered list of configured upstream DNS servers.
